high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of a piece of parchment with a handwritten note on it. The parchment is slightly crumpled and has a worn appearance, suggesting it might be old or well-used. The note is addressed to "Rehm" and reads as follows: -- Rehm, The time has come for me to call in an old favor. This adventurer carries the fate of the world on their shoulders. Please, take them where they need to go. Deckard Cain -- At the bottom right corner of the parchment, there is a small illustration of a bird, possibly a raven, which could symbolize wisdom,
